symptom: One-Way failures cannot be correlated to backend logs
root_cause: One-Way UI drops trace_id in prod and logs only request id and status; evidence gap, not a defect.
fix: Temporarily enable obs.oneway_u.verbose_log (global, log volume risk) and correlate by timestamp.
detection_tip: Enable obs.oneway_u.verbose_log for a short window; correlate to q.* by timestamp.
